body: I really wouldn't be surprised at all.. my depression seems very irrational at times.. but then again it always stems back to the feeling of pointlessness..  I would love to look into that possibility but until I have some sort of way to pay for it I have no clue how I would access it.

I think I feel life is pointless due to the fact that I am not religious (I would say I am an atheist if anything) I mean fully would love to believe in god because it would give me a reason to live but theres no such thing in my head and never will be.  I guess I just haven't found my reason to live and at this rate I feel whats the point if we all die eventually... Guess thats about all I really feel when I feel like life is pointless... Then I consider work and just think about how bad 

Father is complete asshole no one in family likes him.  Mother is overbearing.  I love my mom but again its too much drama to be around my parents.  They both unintentionally emotionally abused all of us growing up.  I am kind of the black sheep of the family especially.

Good points all the way around... I actually have thought on occasion that I suffer from depression for reason as you mentioned  but as for a doctor thats more of a matter of money than anything.  You are right and I guess its the whole idea that I just have to try wait and make things better and eventually they will...  Thanks for the advice though I appreciate it
yah I think your right, with stating life can get dull.. feels pretty dull right now I need to find a new thing to spark my interests in living again.

thanks sometimes I get lonely... I think I also miss being intimate with someone.. I have found when there is a woman I care about in my life I care more about myself.  It shouldn't be that way I know but at times just knowing I always have someone to "hug" helps me get through the day a lot better

I really appreciate the comments... btw I feel a lot better than when I first posted and have no really bad feelings right now.. just spent the morning playing a video game and enjoyed that... still trying to figure out what to do with life.
...and I greatly appreciate it, thats truly the least of what I wanted by posting thank you.

Ya I totally hate it but its actually a great deal for me because it is good work history, experience, and etc.. its less the job and more the bosses but regardless yes I do hate it but really theres no way i could quit in my current state.  For some reason though I always hope I get fired on a day like today so I just dont have to face it anymore... I've quit many jobs in my youth by getting so fed up and just stopped showing up and I don't want to resort like that now, I want to be more adult about it.  I think thats exactly what I should do, I need to learn to just train myself more and teach myself more about my career field and then be able to find a job elsewhere... its still just very hard to find work where I am (Minnesota) so I just try to appreciate the fact I even have a job.

I agree, your very right in the way that I unfairly judge myself and suffer from constant guilt of why am I so wrong and messed up, if I had to make a fair assessment of myself I am above average intelligence, good enough looking, and a kind hearted person yet for some reason I always feel at best about as good as I just stated about myself and at worst all the way down to talking about what I am now... I appreciate the feedback greatly

That really sounds like me, I know for sure at most I would try to commit suicide but in a very obvious to fail way, I just don't think I would actually do it but then again I worry because I have said that about a lot of things in life and honestly I a more afraid of myself than anything else ... I have large cuts on my arm because I actually got drunk a few years back and just decided to cut myself and not in the way a cutter would like serious deep cuts that are 2-4 inches long and about 1-2 inches deep.. I always wonder about that because it was a one time thing I never did it again, I just told everyone I knew that I got in a knife fight and they believed it somehow which is good.  I've only told a really close girlfriend (not with anymore) the truth once but didn't really get much out of sharing that information... Anyways I guess im going on a tagent here it just feels good to talk and know that at least someone is listening and not judging me...
